greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen. Makube nani uxolo nothando lukaThixo uYise, nalo lonke ukhuseleko lukaMariya, uMama wethu.
penitential: Nkosi, ube nemfesane kuthi. Kristu, ube nemfesane kuthi. Nkosi, ube nemfesane kuthi.
psalm_response: Phumani niye kwihlabathi liphela, nishumayele iindaba ezilungileyo.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho uBenjamin Vo, esesemncinci, ehleli phantsi phambi kwekhompyutha yakhe, ebhala iikhowudi zokudala umdlalo omtsha okanye ecwangcisa indlela i-'con chim airlines' yakhe eya kubhabha ngayo. Kwakukho ukuzimisela okukhulu emehlweni akhe, ukuzimisela okungazange kwabangelwa kukufuna ukubonwa ngabantu, kodwa ngenxa yokuba wayeyithanda inyaniso yento awayeyenza. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwakha, ukudala, nokuzisa uvuyo. Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi kaGalati, uPawulos uthi: 'Ngenxa yokuba wayeyithanda inyaniso yento awayeyenza.' Umpostile usikhumbuza ukuba ubomi bethu abuyiyo imidlalo yokukholisa abantu, kodwa bubudlelwane obunzulu noKristu.

KwiVangeli, abafundi bacela uYesu: 'Nkosi, sifundise ukuthandaza.' UYesu akabaphenduli ngokubaxelela imithetho enzima, kodwa ubafundisa ukuthandaza njengabantwana abajonge uYise: 'Tata, malingcwaliswe igama lakho.' Lo ngumthandazo owawukwintliziyo kaBen. Wayengumfana owayejonga kude, owayejonga phezulu, owayefuna ukubona ubukhulu bukaThixo kwiinkcukacha ezincinci zobomi—kwiindiza, kwiikhowudi, nakuthando olukhulu awayenalo ngabazali bakhe. UBen wayeyazi ukuba ukubaluleka kobomi akukho ekwenzeni izinto ezininzi, kodwa ekubeni nentliziyo evulekileyo.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba iinyanga ezintathu ezi zidlulileyo bezinzima kakhulu. Ndiyazi ukuba kukho amaxesha apho intliziyo iziva ngathi iyaphuka, xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana owayeza kuwe, owayekuthanda, owayekujonga ngamehlo anothando. Usizi alulandeli ikhalenda. Luza ngexesha lalo, lunzima, lufuna indawo. Ndaye ndifuna ukuba uthethe inyaniso yale ntliziyo yakho namhlanje. Akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo.

Khumbula indlela uBen awayenentliziyo enobubele ngayo. Khumbula loo mzuzu xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana owayenokunikela ngayo yonke into yakhe ngaphandle kokubala. Wayengumfana owayephila ngoxolo lukaKristu. WayengumSamariya olungileyo ebomini bakhe, ebonisa uthando olungenamiqathango. UBen wayengumfana owayephila ngoluxolo. Wayengumfana owayezisa uxolo ekhaya. 

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ehamba nawe, ekukhathalele, kwaye uthando lwenu aluzange lufe. Vumela uYesu abe lulwalwa lwakho namhlanje. Thatha igama likaBen, thandaza kuye uThixo, kwaye uqhubeke uphila ngesibindi, wazi ukuba akukho lizwi linye lothando olulahlekileyo phambi koThixo. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi eCà Mau, olethela ubomi kwabanye. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lukhanya njengolwandle olukhulu.

UYesu uthi: 'Tata, malingcwaliswe igama lakho.' Lo ngumyalelo wethu namhlanje. Hamba, uthande njengokuba uBen wayethanda. Hamba, ube nomfesane njengokuba uBen wayenaye. Hamba, ube nentliziyo evulekileyo njengokuba uBen wayenayo. Xa uziva usizi, yithi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.' UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Siya kukukhumbula njalo, side sidibane kwakhona apho kungekho nyembezi, apho kukho uvuyo olungunaphakade. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente engcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya nangothando. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ufikile, ndize ndimanyane nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla onke angasithamsanqelisa, asigcine, asikhokelele kubomi obungunaphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abasemlilweni, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba elingapheliyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana noodade bethu: Emva kweminyaka elishumi elinesine ndaphinda ndenyuka ndaya eJerusalem noBharnabas, ndithatha noTitus. Ndanyuka ngokwatyhilwayo kum, ndaza ndabacacisela iVangeli endiyishumayelayo kumaZizwe–kodwa ngasese kwabo babebalulekile–ukuze ndingabaleki, okanye ndingabalekanga, ize. Ngakumbi, xa babona ukuba ndiphathiswe iVangeli yabo bangalukanga, kanye njengoPetros kowabo abalukileyo, kuba lowo wusebenza kuPetros ngenxa yobupostile kubalukileyo wusebenza nakum ngenxa yamaZizwe, kwaye xa babona ubabalo endilunikiweyo, uYakobi noKefas noYohane, ababejongwa njengeentsika, bandinika mna noBharnabas izandla zabo zokusebenzisana, ukuze siye kumaZizwe kwaye bona baye kwabalukileyo. Kuphela, kwakufuneka sikhumbule amahlwempu, nto leyo endandizimisele ukuyenza. Kwaye xa uKefas efika eAntiyokwe, ndamchasa ebusweni kuba wayengalunganga. Kuba, de kwafika abathile bevela kuYakobi, wayedla kunye namaZizwe; kodwa bakufika bona, waqalisa ukurhoxa waza wahlukana nawo, kuba wayesoyika abalukileyo. Kwaye abanye amaJuda benza ngokuzenzisa kunye naye, kangangokuba noBharnabas wakhukuliswa kukuzenzisa kwabo. Kodwa ndakubona ukuba abahambi endleleni elungileyo ngokwenyaniso yeVangeli, ndathi kuKefas phambi kwabantu bonke, 'Ukuba wena, nangona ungumJuda, uphila njengamaZizwe kwaye hayi njengomJuda, unganqobelela njani amaZizwe ukuba aphile njengamaJuda?'

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Phumani niye kwihlabathi liphela, nishumayele iindaba ezilungileyo. Dumisani iNkosi, nina zizwe zonke, yizukiseni, nina bantu bonke! R. Phumani niye kwihlabathi liphela, nishumayele iindaba ezilungileyo. Kuba ububele bayo bunamandla kuthi, kwaye ukuthembeka kweNkosi kuhlala ngonaphakade. R. Phumani niye kwihlabathi liphela, nishumayele iindaba ezilungileyo.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wayethandaza kwindawo ethile, kwaye akugqiba, omnye wabafundi bakhe wathi kuye, 'Nkosi, sifundise ukuthandaza kanye njengokuba uYohane wafundisa abafundi bakhe.' Wathi kubo, 'Xa nithandazayo, yithini: Tata, malingcwaliswe igama lakho, ubukumkani bakho mabufike. Siphe imihla ngemihla isonka sethu semihla ngemihla, usixolele izono zethu, kuba nathi sixolela wonke umntu onetyala kuthi, kwaye ungasifaki kuvavanyo lokugqibela.'

day: Memorial of Our Lady of the Rosary

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
